notes.title: Update Information: January 22, 2020
notes.notes:
This message will explain the free updates coming to DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY NT and DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY NT Free Edition on Thursday January, 22, 2020.

Free Update

■Character Rank Additions and Adjustments
■Ultima Rank Addition
Ultima Class will be added as a rank higher than Crystal Class 

・Ultima Class Mode
This is an addition to Online battles only
This has not been added to Offline Battles.

■Ultima Battles
With the addition of Ultima Class, Ultima Battles will also be implemented. 

We hope you continue to enjoy DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY NT.

notes.title: Update Information: April 25, 2019
notes.notes:
Here you can find information about the free update on April 25, 2019.
Free Update (Steam Only)

[b]System Changes[/b]
In order to reduce latency during ranked matches, players will no longer be matched against each other if they are geographically far apart.
We hope you continue to enjoy DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY NT.

notes.title: Dissidia Final Fantasy NT limit breaks onto PC with a free version
notes.notes:
Crossover fighter Dissidia Final Fantasy NT isn’t one I ever expected to see on PC, so debuting with a free trial edition makes sense. Originally launched into Japanese arcades and developed by Koei Tecmo’s Team Ninja, Dissidia NT is a messy online six-way team brawler. Players bounce, fly and clamber around large, open arenas trying to whittle down each other’s stats until one party of players stops moving. Its large cast features most Final Fantasy heroes, plus villains like Kefka, although your first few games will mostly resolve around wild, blind flailing. See the console launch trailer below.
